spec_package: OpenMatrix9_Codex_Spec_v2/ is ABSENT locally; the planning tree and AGENTS.md are the only spec sources.
m00_scope: Only QymCAD code reuse is approved (2026-10-16). Nothing in this module needs OCCT, 3DM, Associative, License or Reproducible decisions. The ui.rs stub swap is UI work and is gated in the integration note, not here.
exclusion: One command engine only: om9-app::session::Controller stays the single dispatcher for menu, mouse, F6 and CMD. No second Rhino/Matrix engine.

TEST om9-app/tests/file_widgets.rs:168 file_menu_and_cmd_dispatch_owned_intents_through_same_controller
gaps: No single registry: IDs/names live in session.rs, file_lifecycle.rs and the UI-only catalog.
The catalog has duplicate command names (Dim x2, ExtrudeCrv x2, gvRPSupportLine x3, ...) and duplicate display names (Boolean, Loft, Revolve, ...) with no ambiguity diagnostic.
Unknown names and IDs return a generic Unsupported; Undo/Redo have no stable ID at all.
